basic_details.job_title: IIMB Resident Hostel Warden Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate from a reputed University / Institute.
qualification.details: Graduate from a reputed University / Institute. Preferably 3 years of prior experience in Hostel administration, residential supervision, or student welfare. Fluent in English; knowledge of Hindi, Kannada advantageous.

salary_details.details: Rs. 640000 Per Annum The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis with a consolidated monthly salary (CTC). The contract is renewable based on satisfactory performance. While the final compensation will be determined by the candidate’s profile, the indicative remuneration is ₹6.40 Lakhs per annum, plus campus accommodation and additional benefits.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIMB to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIMB Resident Hostel Warden position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Resident Hostel Warden post at IIMB is 27th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Resident Hostel Warden role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Resident Hostel Warden position will receive a salary of Rs. 6,40,000 Per Annum.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a reputed University or Institute. Prior experience in hostel administration is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIMB Resident Hostel Warden recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Resident Hostel Warden position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Resident Hostel Warden post at IIMB primarily involves shortlisting of applications.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Resident Hostel Warden post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Resident Hostel Warden at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Resident Hostel Warden post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which mode of application is accepted?
faq.answer: Applications for the Resident Hostel Warden position must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the IIMB Resident Hostel Warden recruitment is IIMB/HR/RECT/2026/52.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxation benefits mentioned?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation benefits for this particular recruitment.
